messages.msg: Q18 proves on ProfileEditor that a shallow copy with a nested assignment changes the module-level initialProfile, so the Reset button shows the new bio; the nested spread keeps Reset correct. Q19 can use the same Reset check when one object inside a state array is changed in place after the array is copied.
messages.resolution: Map 19 copy-changed-item uses the Reset check: a copied array with an assignment to one story leaves Reset showing Corrected; map with an object copy brings back Typo storey.

messages.msg: Q18 works on ArticleForm, which keeps one article in state (title, summary, and an author object with a name and a bio) starting from firstArticle at the top of the file, and has an Undo changes button that calls setArticle(firstArticle). A shallow copy with next.author.bio = ... changes firstArticle.author, so Undo brings back the title and keeps the new bio; the copy at both levels keeps Undo right (verified in React 19.3.1 and Chrome). Q19 can use the same Undo check when one object inside a state array is changed in place after the array is copied. This replaces 18-19-01, which named the archived ProfileEditor.
